summary: Tested CRM Master Price List (iter 220 P1) backend + frontend end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (12 API tests, plus 7 parser tests already passing) all GREEN. Frontend wizard verified through upload + mapping step (4 sheets, 229 column-mapping selects, 4 AI suggest buttons detected). Preview/commit step not fully driven via UI in this run — see notes.

minor.issue: Response payload is nested under top-level 'import' key (not flat). Works correctly; test had to flatten. Worth documenting in client SDKs.
Response payload nested under 'preview' key (not flat). Same note.

ui_bugs.issue: An 'Install App' overlay appears at the bottom of the import wizard during the mapping step and can occlude the Preview/Back buttons, blocking clicks in automated tests. Consider suppressing PWA prompts while a modal wizard is open.

integration_issues.flow: Import wizard - Preview step at full selection
integration_issues.issue: When Main Gym (3951 rows) + Functional Training (174) + Studio Equipment (50) are all selected, the /preview API took >90s in the browser test run. Backend pytest with a tiny sheet returned promptly. Recommend either showing a progress spinner with longer client timeout, or chunking preview server-side for sheets >2k rows.

issues: Workspace already contains 47 imported products from a prior commit (main agent had said data was deleted — verify clean state if a re-import is intended).

action_items: Suppress PWA install prompt while CRM modals are open (or raise its z-index below modal/overlay).
Add front-end loading indicator for preview step and bump client timeout (or chunk preview) for sheets >2k rows.
Optional: flatten the upload/preview response shapes (or document the {import:{...}} / {preview:{...}} envelope).
Verify the org's product list was actually cleared as expected before next run (47 products still present).
critical_code_review_comments: Two response payloads (upload, preview) use a non-obvious top-level envelope key. Either always wrap consistently or document.
Front-end should not let a PWA prompt overlay a critical wizard CTA; add a CSS rule or feature flag while wizard open.
Preview heuristic for thousands of rows is expensive — consider returning preview summaries incrementally.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (auth, navigation, wizard open, file upload, mapping step verified; preview/commit/drawer not driven through UI this run)
